question: Can two cheaper, action-conditioned diagnostics distinguish the heterogeneous exact second-public laws in the frozen 12-sector deterministic-first collision class: physical action/error overlap, or one- and two-site public charge marginals?
fork_classification: Action-support geometry and low-order public-record marginals are independent, reversible, in-scope diagnostics computable together from the fixed J8X matrix at zero new Born cost. Run both branches in one bounded matrix; neither can be promoted to an operator symmetry without later direct validation.
frozen_model: Only the exact remediated R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 J8X result at p_X=1/10, p_Z=0: 12 equal-prior same-first-flux three-edge pairs, complete all-zero-charge first record of likelihood one, and relation-free public actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35]. Private error supports are used only for physical-signature analysis; never exposed as an action input.

hypotheses.geometry_sufficient_on_class: Within each action, every repeated sorted action/error overlap plus action/pair-XOR overlap signature has the same exact full second-law TV. This is only an in-class necessary diagnostic, not a law-reuse proof.
hypotheses.geometry_conflict: At least one identical action-overlap signature has different exact full second-law TV; that geometry summary cannot justify pooling.
hypotheses.low_order_sufficient_on_class: Every full-law TV equals the largest one-site or two-site charge-marginal TV, respectively; this describes only the frozen class.
hypotheses.joint_information: At least one complete-public-law contrast exceeds every one- or two-site charge-marginal contrast, so lower-order marginals lose finite discrimination.
hypotheses.censored: Any replay, normalization, source hash, marginal contraction, CPU or zero-Born integrity gate fails; do not promote partial diagnostic evidence.

matrix.cells: All 12 immutable J8X sector pairs crossed with both actions. For each, replay complete-law TV, compute maximum exact TV over all 24 one-charge-bit marginals and all 276 two-charge-bit marginals. Independently calculate sorted pair action/error support intersections and action/pair-XOR intersection, then test whether any repeated signature within an action maps to conflicting exact full TVs.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact sector-pair/action cell; no stochastic uncertainty or fitted classifier.
matrix.integrity: Pin J8X result and law parser; verify all 24 first masses equal one, 24 full-TV replays, 7,200 exact marginal comparisons, data processing max-single<=max-pair<=full, 24 cells, zero new Born terms/histories/arms/bootstraps, source/hash stability and CPU cap.

acceptance: Both candidate diagnostic families are evaluated on all 24 frozen action cells
Every full-TV and marginal inequality replays exactly, with repeated overlap-signature conflicts listed
Any sufficiency statement is limited to this finite class and cannot assert operator automorphism, full-IID information/risk, noisy JIT or threshold
stop_rule: Stop after the fixed 24 cells, 7,200 marginal comparisons or first integrity/10-CPU-second cap; no adaptive feature search, new public law, history or budget increase.
